tokens.name: duration/toast-visible
tokens.description: How long a Toast stays on screen before it dismisses itself (5s). Not an animation: the Toaster in code reads it, and pauses it while the pointer is over the stack, focus is inside it or the page is hidden. Its exit then runs at duration/xl.

tokens.name: duration/tooltip-delay
tokens.description: How long the pointer rests on a trigger before its Tooltip opens (500ms). Not an animation: Tooltip in code reads it as its hover delay. Keyboard focus opens a tooltip at once, and once one tooltip is open the next opens without the delay. The tooltip then shows at duration/xs.

tokens.name: duration/tooltip-close-delay
tokens.description: How long a Tooltip stays after the pointer leaves its trigger (100ms), so the pointer can cross onto the tooltip without it closing. Not an animation: Tooltip in code reads it as its close delay. Escape, blur and a press close it at once.

tokens.name: duration/typing
tokens.description: One cycle of the typing indicator: the three dots of a typing Chat bubble lift and brighten in turn, then repeat (a loop, not a one-off animation). Code: duration/typing.

tokens.name: duration/sidebar-peek-delay
tokens.description: How long the pointer rests on a minimized Sidebar before it opens over the page. Moving restarts the wait, so passing over the rail never opens it. A delay, not an animation. Code: the Sidebar peekDelay prop defaults to it.

tokens.name: duration/sidebar-peek-close-delay
tokens.description: How long an open minimized Sidebar waits after the pointer leaves before it closes, so a brief exit does not close it. A delay, not an animation. Code: the Sidebar peekCloseDelay prop defaults to it.

tokens.name: duration/scrollbar-hide-delay
tokens.description: How long a scrollbar stays after scrolling stops before it fades out (1s, the macOS overlay scrollbar standard). Scrollbars show only while an area scrolls or its thumb is held. A delay, not an animation: ScrollArea in code reads it; the thumb then fades at duration/md.

tokens.name: duration/copied-visible
tokens.description: How long a copy button shows its Check and says Copied after a copy (2s, the common standard), whether or not the pointer stays on it. Not an animation: Code snippet and Code text read it in code, then the Copy icon comes back.
